messages:
anthony_acme: Hi — I'm blocked from the project console (org: acme-corp, project: payments) after our IdP maintenance. Browser shows "You don't have permissions to view this project" and API calls return 403. I accepted an invite earlier today. Can someone help?

maria_support: Sorry about that, anthony. Can you paste the exact timestamp you first saw it and the email you used? Any recent Okta/SCIM changes on your side?

anthony_acme: Email anthony@acme.com. First saw it around 2026-03-15T18:22Z. Our Okta team ran a cleanup this morning that trimmed some group attributes. Here's the curl I ran:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <SERVICE_TOKEN>" 
  -X GET https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/projects/pm-012345 
  -i
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 18:22:10 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "forbidden",
  "message": "user does not have role on project"
}
```

maria_support: thanks. @kevin_infra can you take a look at SCIM/group->role mapping for acme-corp? I'm going to pull the audit logs now.

okta-bot: SCIM sync event id=evt-84321 user=anthony@acme.com group="x-acme-project-payments-admins-very-long-group-name-which-was-trimmed" action=group_membership_updated ts=2026-03-15T18:20:05Z

kevin_infra: looking. I can see SCIM payload where Okta sent group.displayName truncated with an ellipsis: "x-acme-project-payments-admins-very-long-grou…". Our SCIM onboarding expects exact group name -> role mapping, so when the claim doesn't match the mapping, the role binding is not applied. Repro steps: 1) create Okta group with displayName >64 chars; 2) run SCIM push; 3) our mapping fails and user becomes member without role.

maria_support: that explains the 403. Two options: 1) short-term we can grant anthony project:admin via support console; 2) long-term we need Okta transform or SCIM mapping change. Anthony — do you want us to apply the temp grant?

anthony_acme: yes please, we need immediate access.

maria_support: applying project admin to anthony@acme.com for project pm-012345 now (support action id=supp-90812) — please refresh.

anthony_acme: I can see the project now, console access restored. Thank you.

kevin_infra: For permanent fix I'll open infra ticket INFRA-4521 and loop in Okta. Short term recommendations: 1) rename Okta group to < 64 chars; or 2) update Okta claim transform to emit a stable short group_name claim used for mapping. Root cause: IdP truncated group displayName causing mismatch during SCIM/group claim mapping.

maria_support: noted. Marking thread resolved after temp grant. If this happens again we'll re-open and apply the infra remediation. :white_check_mark:
